capabilities: Answer questions with numbered citations retrieved from one or more vaults
Search multiple vaults through federated OHS MCP endpoints
Open cited notes at the matching passage using preview anchors
Configure OpenAI-compatible chat provider profiles with streamed answers
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.13+, macOS/Windows/Linux, not mobile or web). The plugin does no indexing, embedding, or reindexing itself and is not bundled with OHS; manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Chat sessions and retrieved source text are stored in plugin data.json and may sync with the vault.
